title: Luna Max + Goal + Audit skill has been running for 24 hours polishing a game
author: Orlandogameschool
selftext:
Pro plan been using sol for planning in light and LUNA MAX for work. 

things have been going well this project has been working non stop for 24 hours. I’ve checked on it fed it 3d models steered  it but it’s stayed on track to polish visuals until they look AA

Not everything has to be one shotted. Luna is slow but it works. The game looks good already 

My current workflow looks like this. 

Game idea 💡 - research the idea with deep research 

Master prompt made with gpt to make a vertical slice of the game or MVP

Tell gpt I’m about to send this to codex make me SKILLS to make this game faster 

Tell gpt visualize this game make in game screen shots main menu and more generate pictures 

Make general game development skills for codex, I’ll post a few of mine in the comments. 

Find open source art and 3d models for placeholders to avoid wasting time modeling 

Feed all the that to codex put it on SOL light in plan mode implement the first pass with sol then switch the Luna max set a goal and let it work.

comments.author: heavy-minium
comments.body:
Yeah, that was the working combo for me too previously (have now switched to stronger and faster models), with /goal , keeping track in repository, max reasoning, and max context size.

Luna has done badly in some benchmark but extremely good in others.   
The difference in outcomes comes from Luna suffering quickly from context compaction, not being smart enough to recover from a loss of information or mistaking its own output as instructions, and it happens faster because luna on max reasoning is very verbose. That's why the benchmark vary extremely on its measured performance, depending on how the harness is used, whether the task is long-horizon and will cause constant compaction, what context size was allowed, and whether there is something like /goal forcing it to stick to a goal (which won't be affected by compaction).
